description: Implementation of AppDelegate for a WebKit-based macOS application, managing window creation, web view configurations, browser contexts, and delegate methods for navigation and dialogs.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: Custom dialog class for handling JavaScript dialogs within WKWebView.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing window creation, web view configurations, browser contexts, and delegate methods for a WebKit-based macOS app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app delegate, processes command-line arguments, and sets up headless or headful mode.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Sets up the initial window or headless environment after app launch.

methods.name: createNewPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView page, either headless or headful based on mode.

methods.name: createHeadlessPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a headless WKWebView embedded in a borderless window.

methods.name: createHeadfulPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a visible WKWebView within a standard window.

methods.name: createBrowserContext:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified proxy settings.

methods.name: deleteBrowserContext:
methods.description: Removes a browser context by session ID.

methods.name: sessionConfiguration:
methods.description: Provides a WKWebViewConfiguration for a given session ID.

methods.name: createNewPage:
methods.description: Creates a new page with default session ID.

methods.name: webViewDidClose:
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a web view is closed.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationAction:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides navigation policy for a web view, handling new window creation and download requests.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationResponse:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or download content based on response headers.
